Our view

Clear advice when it matters most.

By the partners · 6 min read
A boutique law firm for businesses and families, with partners you can call directly.

Most people come to a lawyer late, worried, and with a pile of paper. We try to make the first conversation short and useful: what is going on, what the options are, what each will cost and what we would do. No jargon, and no billing surprises.

A firm of eleven lawyers

How we work
One

Partners do the work

You will not be handed to a junior after the pitch. Partners are on every file.

Honest about odds

If a case is weak, or settling is wiser, we will say so.

A beginner's guide to corporate & commercial

Everything you need to know before you start.

TTan Sri Dr Lim12 March 2026

Good writing starts with a clear question. In this article we explore the idea in plain language, with examples you can use straight away.

The first thing to understand is that small decisions compound. Choosing carefully at the start saves far more time than it costs, and it makes every later step easier.

We have tested these approaches with real clients over several years. Some worked immediately; others needed adjusting. Here is what we learned.

Three things to remember

  • Start with the outcome you want.
  • Test small before you commit.
  • Write down what you learn.
